tools.name: llui_get_state
tools.description: Get the current state of the active LLui component. Returns a JSON-serializable state object. (Switch which component is targeted with llui_select_component.)

tools.name: llui_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the component and return the new state and effects. Validates the message first. send() is synchronous in the signal runtime.

msg.description: The message to send (must be a valid Msg variant)

tools.name: llui_eval_update
tools.description: Dry-run: call update(state, msg) without applying. Returns what the new state and effects would be without modifying the running app.

tools.name: llui_validate_message
tools.description: Validate a message against the component Msg type. Returns errors or null if valid.

tools.name: llui_get_message_history
tools.description: Get the chronological message history with state transitions and effects. Supports pagination via `since` (exclusive, return entries with index > since) and `limit` (return at most N most-recent entries). Use both together for tail-fetching.

since.description: Return entries with index strictly greater than this.

limit.description: Max entries to return (the N most recent).

tools.name: llui_export_trace
tools.description: Export the current session as a replayable LluiTrace JSON.

tools.name: llui_search_state
tools.description: Search current state using a dot-separated path query. E.g., "cart.items" returns the items array.

tools.name: llui_clear_log
tools.description: Clear the message and effects history.

tools.name: llui_list_messages
tools.description: List all message variants the component accepts, with their field types. Returns { discriminant, variants: { [name]: { [field]: typeDescriptor } } }. Use this to discover what messages can be sent without reading source code.

tools.name: llui_component_info
tools.description: Get component name and source location (file + line) of the component() declaration. Lets you find where to read or edit the component.

tools.name: llui_describe_state
tools.description: Return the State type's shape (not its value). Fields map to type descriptors: 'string', 'number', 'boolean', {kind:'enum',values:[...]}, {kind:'array',of:...}, {kind:'object',fields:...}, {kind:'optional',of:...}. Use this to know what fields exist and their types even when currently undefined.

tools.name: llui_list_effects
tools.description: List all effect variants the component emits, with their field types (same format as llui_list_messages). Returns null if no Effect type is declared.

tools.name: llui_snapshot_state
tools.description: Capture the current state (deep clone). Returns the snapshot — store it, then call llui_restore_state later to roll back. Useful for safely exploring transitions during a debugging session.

tools.name: llui_restore_state
tools.description: Overwrite the current state with a previously-captured snapshot and re-render. Bypasses update() — snap must already be a valid state value.

snapshot.description: The state object returned by llui_snapshot_state.

tools.name: llui_list_components
tools.description: List all currently-mounted LLui components + which one is active (being targeted by subsequent tool calls). Multi-mount apps show one entry per mount.

tools.name: llui_select_component
tools.description: Switch the active component (the one all other tool calls target). Use a key from llui_list_components.

key.description: Component key as returned by llui_list_components

tools.name: llui_replay_trace
tools.description: Generate a ready-to-run vitest file that replays the current message history via `replayTrace()` from @llui/test. The output is a complete test file with the trace inlined — paste it into packages/<pkg>/test/ to reproduce the exact sequence of messages the component saw in this session. Use this to capture a debugging session as a regression test.

importPath.description: Where to import the component def from in the generated test (default: '../src/index'). Example: '../src/todo-app'.

exportName.description: Named export that holds the component def (default: the component's name).

tools.name: llui_lint
tools.description: Lint an LLui source file against the @llui/compiler SIGNAL lint rules — the SAME non-bypassable rules the vite-plugin enforces as build errors (peek-in-slot, operator-on-signal, pure-derive-body, no-node-construction-in-body, plus the shared convention / event-handler-casing / attr-name checks). This does NOT run ESLint. Pass an absolute file path on the dev machine. Returns { file, score, violations, summary } where each violation is { rule, message, line, column, fix? } and score is max(0, 20 - violations.length) (20 = clean). For a whole-directory scan use llui_compiler_diagnostics.

path.description: Absolute file path to read and lint (.ts/.tsx).

tools.name: llui_diff_state
tools.description: Structured JSON diff between two state values. Pass 'a' and 'b' — plain objects. Returns { added, removed, changed }.

tools.name: llui_assert
tools.description: Evaluate a predicate against current state. Pass 'path' (dot-separated), 'op' (eq/neq/exists/gt/lt/in), and 'value'. Returns { pass, actual, expected, op }.

tools.name: llui_search_history
tools.description: Filtered message history. Pass 'filter' with { type?, statePath?, effectType?, fromIndex?, toIndex? }. Entries match if all present fields match — type is the Msg discriminant, statePath is a dot path whose value differs pre->post, effectType is a type present in the effects array.

tools.name: llui_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the browser page or a specific element. Returns base64-encoded PNG or JPEG. Requires CDP transport (browser attached via :9222 or Playwright fallback).

selector.description: CSS selector — screenshot only this element

tools.name: llui_a11y_tree
tools.description: Return the accessibility tree for the page or a specific element. Useful for verifying ARIA roles, labels, and keyboard navigation structure.

selector.description: Root element CSS selector (default: full page)

interestingOnly.description: Omit nodes with no accessibility-relevant attributes (default true)

tools.name: llui_network_tail
tools.description: Return recent network requests captured since the CDP session started. Includes URL, method, status, timing, and failure info.

limit.description: Max entries to return (default: all buffered, max 500)

status.description: HTTP status code to filter on

tools.name: llui_console_tail
tools.description: Return recent browser console entries (log, info, warn, error, debug) captured since the CDP session started.

tools.name: llui_uncaught_errors
tools.description: Return recent uncaught JavaScript exceptions captured since the CDP session started.

tools.name: llui_browser_close
tools.description: Close the Playwright-owned fallback browser and clear the CDP session buffers. No-op if the browser is user-owned (attached via :9222).

tools.name: llui_static_show_compiled
tools.description: Static counterpart of `llui_show_compiled`. Read a source file from disk and return its pre-transform source plus the post-transform output @llui/compiler would produce. Works without a running app.

file.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a .ts/.tsx file. Reads the file from disk and runs the compiler transform on it.

tools.name: llui_static_collect_paths
tools.description: Return the reactive state-access dependency paths the @llui/compiler would extract from a file (the paths the runtime gates each binding on), with a per-top-level-field breakdown. Paths are reported at full depth (`user.profile.address.city`, not a two-segment prefix). Companion to `llui_explain_mask` (live) — works without a running app, useful for understanding why a binding does/does not pick up a state change. `opaque` is true when a binding reads the whole state and so cannot be gated on any narrower path.

file.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a .ts/.tsx file.

tools.name: llui_find_msg_producers
tools.description: Find all send({type: "msgType"}) call sites in the project source. Returns file path, line, column, and surrounding context for each hit.

msgType.description: The Msg variant type string to search for

rootDir.description: Root directory to search (defaults to workspace root)

tools.name: llui_find_msg_handlers
tools.description: Find all update() function branches that handle a specific Msg variant. Returns file, line, column, and context for each case arm.

msgType.description: The Msg variant type string to search for

rootDir.description: Root directory to search (defaults to workspace root)

tools.name: llui_run_test
tools.description: Run a vitest test file (and optionally a specific test name). Returns pass/fail status and captured output.

file.description: Absolute path to the test file

testName.description: Test name pattern to filter (-t flag)

tools.name: llui_compiler_diagnostics
tools.description: Run the @llui/compiler signal lint rules against every .ts/.tsx file in a directory and return the union of structured diagnostics. Each diagnostic has { id, severity, category, message, file, line, column } — the same rules the vite-plugin surfaces as build errors. Rename-style rules (convention, event-handler-casing, attr-name) also include a `fix` { title, edits: [{ start, end, oldText, newText }] } you can apply directly to the source. Use this to inspect a project for LLui rule violations without spinning up a full Vite build.

rootDir.description: Directory to scan (defaults to workspace root)

idFilter.description: Optional substring filter on diagnostic id — e.g. "agent-emits" matches both agent-emits-drift entries.

tools.name: llui_hydration_report
tools.description: Compare the server-rendered HTML (from @llui/vike) against the current client DOM and return divergences. Each divergence includes the DOM path, kind (attribute/text/structural), and the server vs client values. Returns an empty array when hydration is clean.

tools.name: llui_ssr_render
tools.description: Server-render the active component using its current state and return the resulting HTML string. Requires @llui/vike to be installed. Useful for verifying that the server output matches what you expect before hydration.

state.description: State override (defaults to current component state)

tools.name: llui_list_notes
tools.description: List notes in the devmode-annotate notebook. Returns frontmatter summaries (id, ts, author, kind, url, componentPath, preview). Filter by author/kind/since; default session is the current one.

sessionId.description: Session id to read. Defaults to the current session.

kind.description: Filter by NoteKind: rect | element | text | capture | reply. Pass an array for multiple.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only notes created strictly after this are returned.

limit.description: Max number of notes to return. Default 50.

tools.name: llui_read_note
tools.description: Read one note: frontmatter, prose, and the body JSON block (state snapshot, message log, effects, dirty trace — when present). Returns the raw markdown as well so it can be pasted into a downstream tool.

id.description: Note id, e.g. "001". Padded to 3 digits per session.

tools.name: llui_list_sessions
tools.description: List all known notebook sessions on disk. Newest sessions appear last (lexicographically sorted by name, which is ISO-shape).

tools.name: llui_current_session
tools.description: Return metadata about the active notebook session: id, ISO start time, and the absolute on-disk notesDir. Useful as a fast 'is the notebook initialized' probe.

tools.name: llui_capture
tools.description: LLM-initiated capture. Asks the connected HUD to screenshot the current page and write a note to the notebook; falls back to a headless Playwright browser when no HUD is connected (requires `playwright` installed). The tool long-polls until fulfillment, timeout, or both paths exhaust. Returns the resulting note inline (markdown + frontmatter + base64 screenshot) so a follow-up llui_read_note call isn't required. Annotation coordinates are viewport pixels — leave `annotate` empty if you only want a clean snapshot. Use this when you want a current visual of the page; use llui_list_notes / llui_read_note to read what the human has already written.

prose.description: Prose body for the captured note (markdown).

annotate.description: Pre-baked annotations in viewport pixel coordinates. Schema matches Annotation from @llui/vite-plugin (rect, lasso, pin, arrow, element, highlight). The Playwright fallback does not bake annotations onto the screenshot (skipped silently in v1); the HUD path bakes them.

forceMode.description: Override auto-select: 'hud' skips the Playwright fallback; 'playwright' goes straight to headless capture without contacting the HUD.

tools.name: llui_rotate_session
tools.description: Start a fresh notebook session. The previous session is left on disk untouched; only the active-session marker moves. Useful when starting a new debugging thread.

tools.name: llui_queue
tools.description: List notes that are participating in the task workflow, with their current status. Defaults to 'open', 'claimed', 'in-progress' — the work that's still active. Pass `status` to filter, or `status: ['accepted', 'applied']` to see what's already done.

tools.name: llui_claim_note
tools.description: Atomically claim a task note for processing. Reads the current status — if no one else has claimed it (status is null or 'open'), appends a 'claimed' transition and returns the note contents. If already claimed by another worker, returns the current claimant. Use a unique workerId per LLM session so concurrent workers don't double-process.

workerId.description: Stable identifier for the claimer (e.g. session id).

tools.name: llui_reply_to_note
tools.description: Write a reply note (kind: 'reply') that answers a task. When `proposedDiff` is included, the reply is also a candidate for `accepted` status to drive auto-apply via `git apply`. Status transitions: if the original task is currently 'claimed' or 'in-progress', this call also appends a 'proposed' transition for it.

prose.description: Markdown prose body for the reply.
